Its Clogged

Its Clogged is a game where you play as a hotel janitor cleaning various bathrooms for the guests. As the story progresses, you will unlock more cleaning tools and face more difficult rooms to clean up.

Technical Art

As the technical artist, I created various shaders for the game’s visual in Unity HLSL and C#. I also optimized a water simulation algorithm using GPU compute shaders to allow for real-time simulation of over 60k particles.
